# Elm w Noor (علم ونور) - Student Life Agency

> Elm w Noor is a static bilingual website for Arab students studying in Malaysia. The English section in `/en/` is a small content tree built with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript, and it focuses on university guidance, student services, life in Malaysia, and long-form editorial content.

Things to remember when working with Elm w Noor:

- The project is a **static website**, not an app or API service
- The site is **bilingual** and uses Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) pages
- The English pages in `/en/` are **not fully uniform**; some still keep Arabic meta text, headings, or mixed-language content in the source
- Interactivity is handled with **vanilla JavaScript** only
- The design system uses the turquoise brand color `#0F9D92` with yellow, orange, and purple accents
- SEO matters: pages use canonical links, alternate hreflang tags, social meta tags, and JSON-LD on selected pages
- Assets are shared across the site through `/css/style.css`, `/js/main.js`, `/js/gtag-init.js`, and `/images/`

## English Site Map

```text
/en/index.html                          Home page with hero copy, services summary, student feedback, trip section, and majors CTA
/en/universities.html                   University directory, detailed MMU profile, pricing drawer, and admissions information
/en/services.html                       Service catalogue for enrollment, academic help, airport pickup, visa, housing, communities, guides, and materials
/en/life-in-malaysia-student-guide.html  Long-form guide for living in Malaysia, especially for Cyberjaya students
/en/computer-science-guide.html         Computer Science and IT majors guide with fees, universities, and application advice
/en/articles.html                       Strategic article on Malaysia 2026 and student safety, living costs, and guidance for parents
/en/404.html                            English not-found page
```

## What the English Pages Cover

- The home page presents Elm w Noor as a student support agency and links into universities, services, the life guide, and articles
- The universities page centers on Multimedia University and includes a structured fee drawer plus program tables
- The services page groups the agency offering into student environment, registration, academic guidance, airport reception, visa help, accommodation, Arabic communities, a life guide, and study materials
- The life guide is a practical student-living article covering safety, housing, communication, food, money, transport, loneliness, and the final decision to study in Malaysia
- The computer science guide is a discipline-specific article for IT and CS applicants, with admissions, tuition, university options, and final tips
- The articles page is a long strategic report about Malaysia in 2026, including geopolitics, economics, academic reputation, culture, legal safety, healthcare, and parent reassurance
- The 404 page is a simple fallback page for missing routes

## Shared Technical Notes

- HTML uses semantic structure such as `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `aside`, and `footer`
- Google Analytics is initialized through `/js/gtag-init.js`
- Fonts and icons are loaded from Google Fonts and Font Awesome CDNs
- Language changes are implemented with the existing bilingual JavaScript system elsewhere in the site
- Images are mostly WebP and are used for hero art, covers, and supporting visuals

## Editing Guidance

- Keep Arabic and English content aligned when updating shared site messaging
- Preserve canonical URLs, language alternates, and metadata when adding or changing pages
- Prefer small, consistent updates over broad rewrites
- Keep the English folder inventory in sync with the actual HTML files that exist
